jxp_a_105_clear_unification_method_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_blade
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_edict
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_league
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_105_unification_blade
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_105_unification_edict
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_105_unification_league
	}
}

jxp_a_105_reconcile_unification_method_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_105_clear_unification_method_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_24_unification_by_blade }
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_blade
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_105_unification_blade duration = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_24_unification_by_edict }
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_edict
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_105_unification_edict duration = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_24_unification_by_league }
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_league
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_105_unification_league duration = -1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { jxp_is_unified_japan_state_trigger = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_frontier_legacy
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_communal_legacy
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_blade
				add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_105_unification_blade duration = -1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_commercial_legacy
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_maritime_legacy
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_league
				add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_105_unification_league duration = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_edict
				add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_105_unification_edict duration = -1 }
			}
			}
		}
	}
}

	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_105_clear_profile_models_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_uncommitted
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = jxp_a_105_model_uncommitted
			duration = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { mission_completed = jxp_a_105_uncommitted_domestic_8 }
			set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_capstone_complete
			set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_uncommitted_ready
		}
	}

jxp_a_105_reconcile_profile_configuration_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_uncommitted_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_uncommitted_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_sakoku_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_sakoku_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_open_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_open_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_buddhist_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_buddhist_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_kirishitan_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_kirishitan_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_confucian_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_confucian_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_imperial_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_imperial_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_reformed_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_reformed_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_kaikyo_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_kaikyo_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_ikko_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_ikko_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_wokou_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_wokou_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_toyotomi_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_toyotomi_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_commercial_council_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_apply_commercial_council_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else = { jxp_a_105_clear_profile_models_effect = yes }
	}
}

jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_branch_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_shogunate
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_merchant
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_company
		remove_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_council_state_reform
		remove_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_shogunate_reform
		remove_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_merchant_council_reform
		remove_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_company_empire_reform
	}
}

jxp_a_105_set_commercial_shogunate_branch_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_branch_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { government = monarchy } }
			change_government_to_monarchy = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_shogunate
		add_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_shogunate_reform
		override_country_name = JXP_COMMERCIAL_COUNCIL_JAPAN
		regenerate_government_mechanics = yes
	}
}

jxp_a_105_set_commercial_merchant_branch_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_branch_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { government = republic } }
			change_government_to_republic = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_merchant
		add_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_merchant_council_reform
		override_country_name = JXP_COMMERCIAL_MERCHANT_REPUBLIC

jxp_a_105_set_commercial_company_branch_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_branch_effect = yes

			limit = { NOT = { government = monarchy } }

		add_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_company_empire_reform

	}

jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_council_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = jxp_path_commercial_council
					has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_commercial_council
					has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_shogunate
					has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_merchant
					has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_company
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = jxp_path_commercial_council
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_commercial_council
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_state_shareholding
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_shogunate
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_merchant
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_company
			clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_commercial_council_ready
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_crisis_unlocked
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_crisis_pressure
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_crisis_active
			clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_capstone_complete
			clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_company_state_route
			jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_crisis_outcomes_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_branch_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_clear_profile_models_effect = yes
			restore_country_name = yes
		}
	}
}

jxp_a_105_enter_commercial_council_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_clear_all_route_flags_effect = yes
		jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_council_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = jxp_path_commercial_council
		override_country_name = JXP_COMMERCIAL_COUNCIL_JAPAN
		jxp_grant_route_reforms_effect = yes

		jxp_a_105_reconcile_founder_legacy_effect = yes

jxp_a_105_exit_commercial_council_route_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_merchant
				government = republic
			}
			change_government_to_monarchy = yes
		}
		jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_council_effect = yes
		regenerate_government_mechanics = yes
	}
}

jxp_a_105_reconcile_commercial_council_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_profile_commercial_council_trigger = yes }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_company } jxp_a_105_set_commercial_company_branch_effect = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_merchant } jxp_a_105_set_commercial_merchant_branch_effect = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_commercial_branch_shogunate } jxp_a_105_set_commercial_shogunate_branch_effect = yes }
			else = {
				override_country_name = JXP_COMMERCIAL_COUNCIL_JAPAN
				add_government_reform = jxp_a_105_commercial_council_state_reform
			}
			jxp_a_105_apply_commercial_council_profile_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_path_commercial_council }
			jxp_a_105_clear_commercial_council_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

jxp_a_105_reconcile_mission_profile_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_any_domestic_profile_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_profile_configuration_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { jxp_a_105_mission_profile_fingerprint_valid_trigger = yes } }
				jxp_refresh_route_missions_effect = yes
			}
		}
		else = { jxp_a_105_clear_profile_models_effect = yes }
	}
}

jxp_a_105_migrate_mission_schema_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { jxp_a_105_mission_profile_fingerprint_valid_trigger = yes } }
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_mission_profile_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_legacy_snapshot_captured
				jxp_a_105_mission_profile_fingerprint_valid_trigger = yes
			}
			jxp_a_105_replay_mission_progress_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { jxp_a_105_mission_profile_fingerprint_valid_trigger = yes }
				jxp_a_105_clear_superseded_mission_modifiers_effect = yes
				jxp_a_105_restore_buddhist_council_parent_effect = yes
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_105_mission_schema_v1
				jxp_a_105_clear_legacy_mission_progress_effect = yes
				clr_country_flag = jxp_a_105_legacy_snapshot_captured
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_105_mission_profile_fingerprint_valid_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_105_clear_superseded_mission_modifiers_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_restore_buddhist_council_parent_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_105_mission_schema_v1
		}
	}
}
